settings.heading: What to Expect
settings.body: Most repairs take around 2–3 weeks, though special stones, custom cutting or more extensive damage can add extra time — we'll give you a realistic timeframe once we've had a proper look. If we don't have your original valuation on hand, we measure the setting, compare any remaining stones and check hallmarks to match materials exactly. Every visit also includes a complimentary ring clean and inspection, so small issues get caught early.

settings.heading: Beyond the Repair
settings.body: A repair is also a good moment to update a piece — we offer a complete design service, and if an insurer's covering part of the cost, you can simply pay the difference for any changes you'd like. For antique pieces, we can source old-cut stones to keep the original character intact. And every repair is guaranteed against faulty workmanship, with secure, fully insured delivery if you're sending items to us rather than visiting in person.

settings.hero_tagline: Restoring the pieces you wear every day
settings.hero_intro: From a loose stone to a broken clasp, our workshop handles repairs of every scale — with the option to refresh the design at the same time, if you'd like.
